consentText: Taking part is voluntary. This pilot compares fictional practice calls before and after four weeks of practice, with a follow-up two weeks later. It is not a medical assessment or proof that you are safe from scams. No real financial details are needed. Authorized study administrators can export your survey totals and practice scores under a random participant ID. You can leave the pilot and delete your pilot responses at any time. Your ordinary account and practice history remain available.
citation: James, Boyle and Bennett (2014), Journal of Elder Abuse and Neglect. Administrator must verify the source and scoring before enabling enrollment.
